product_one_liner.value: Multiplier acquires and scales specialized professional-services firms by embedding custom AI and workflow technology in their operations, helping tax, accounting, and advisory professionals serve more clients.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer have no pricing link; the pricing URL did not return a page.

named_customers.notes: I could not verify at least two named customers; the names displayed on the company site are portfolio firms and their leaders, not clearly customers.

eng_blog.notes: The index shows business, talent, and leadership/editorial posts, not at least two engineering posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: No public docs, help center, or developer portal link appears in the homepage navigation or footer.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open job board lists six roles, none with an AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The privacy notice and terms refer generically to AI systems/providers but do not identify a model vendor.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy references UK GDPR; this is a regulatory framework, not expressly a certification. No SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or PCI DSS claim was found.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series B was announced in August 2026, within the preceding 18 months.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The listed sales opening is titled Sales & Business Development Associate, not SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable Ideas index and company posts show no product or major-feature launch in the six-month window; the recent items are editorial, hiring, or company updates.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Allen Shim joined as President and CFO in August 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The open Rooled sales and business-development posting identifies HubSpot as its CRM.
